svg.aria-label: Swipe Deck: Turns a vague idea into a 70 to 110 card deck. You swipe yes, no, absolutely or not sure until the signal meter fills, then it writes the brief.
svg.text: Turns a vague idea into a 70 to 110 card deck. You swipe
yes, no, absolutely or not sure until the signal meter fills,
“A ‘no’ is worth as much as a ‘yes.’”
